staged_source_snapshot.description: Stage 01 reproduced against this staged vulnerable snapshot. Its line map matches the saved ASan trace (`process_page_` line 130, `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link` line 666, `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper` line 362, and `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_` line 3748); sample metadata names `40ca8c73f3d0bd14495f157a67148a3f9bc67a28`, an earlier still-vulnerable commit.

bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 371068253 (flac): Heap-buffer-overflow READ 4 found by fuzz target fuzzer_seek [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/371068253
bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json issue_description / staged sanitizer_trace.txt / staged patch.diff / exact staged vulnerable source
bug_description.normalized: The exact staged 162876-byte witness uses `fuzzer_seek`'s config bytes `75 17 ff` to select Ogg mode, enable chained-stream decoding, and run the command prefix `process_until_end_of_stream`, `reset`, `seek_long(0x1000014000000)`. During the initial full-stream pass, vulnerable `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper()` executes its chained EOS growth block at line 362 and reallocates `aspect->linkdetails` to the 4480-byte heap region later named by ASan, i.e. 80 `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` entries. Because that request size is `5 + aspect->current_linknumber`, the live 80-slot buffer proves this block ran at `current_linknumber == 75`; the same block therefore had already incremented `number_of_links_indexed` to 76, and because ASan still points to this 80-slot allocation at crash time, the preserved indexed count on that array can only be 76..79 before any later link-79 indexing would have grown it to 84. `FLAC__stream_decoder_reset()` / `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_reset()` then rewind the current link indices but keep that 80-slot table and its indexed-link metadata live for the later seek. The third command's huge seek reaches `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_()`, fails to find a target link in the preserved indexed table, and drives `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` into a later BOS scan on the same buffer. Runtime disambiguation is disabled, so the saved artifacts do not isolate which post-reset skip/read transition supplied the final `current_linknumber_advance_read == 80` state. The crash suffix is closed by source plus ASan: in `process_page_()`, the BOS guard `current_linknumber_advance_read >= number_of_links_indexed` is satisfied on that 80-slot array, line 128 forms `current_link = &aspect->linkdetails[80]`, and line 130 reads `current_link->number_of_other_streams` 32 bytes past the 4480-byte region. The fix introduces `check_size_of_link_allocation_()`, initializes `number_of_links_allocated = 4`, and calls the helper before every transition that can advance or read ahead to a new link index.

source.description: First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled chained-stream flag. This makes later Ogg EOS handling and seek-time link walking use the `ogg_decoder_aspect` chained-link bookkeeping that allocates and reuses `linkdetails` across reset.
source.value_from: In the exact witness, config byte 1 is `0x17`, so `oss-fuzz/seek.cc` sets both `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]`: the harness selects Ogg mode and enables chained-stream decoding before initialization and commands run.

sink.description: ASan crash site. `process_page_()` reads `number_of_other_streams` from `current_link = &aspect->linkdetails[current_linknumber_advance_read]`; on the witnessed path that pointer is `&aspect->linkdetails[80]`, one past the live 80-slot heap allocation.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4` at `src/libFLAC/ogg_decoder_aspect.c:130:23` in `process_page_`.

root_cause.description: Beginning-of-link BOS scanning treats `current_linknumber_advance_read` as a direct `linkdetails` index after only the count-based guard at line 127. It never checks that the live allocation still covers that index.
root_cause.note: On the witnessed path this forms `&aspect->linkdetails[80]` on the 80-slot array from step 4. The fix resolves this by inserting `check_size_of_link_allocation_()` before every link advance/read-ahead transition and by initializing `number_of_links_allocated` correctly.

tainted_value_origin.description: First project-side consumer of the concrete attacker-controlled long-seek value. The exact witness decodes `target_sample = 0x1000014000000` here, which is not satisfied by the preserved indexed-link table on the saved path and therefore drives the later `skip_link()` walk.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: The exact command bytes at offsets 3..17 are `20 14 27 00 01 00 00 14 00 00 00 00 00 00 00`. After the first `process_until_end_of_stream` and `reset` opcodes, the `0x27` long-seek opcode and its 8-byte operand decode to `0x1000014000000`, which `FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute()` passes into `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_()`.

parser_admitted.description: The exact witness's first command enters the full Ogg decode pass. The saved allocation stack later shows this pass reached `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper:362` and created the live 80-slot `linkdetails` buffer reused by the crashing seek.
parser_admitted.condition: `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]` are both set, so the harness uses `FLAC__stream_decoder_init_ogg_file()` and chained-stream indexing.

crashing_seek.description: The witness's third command is the long seek `0x1000014000000`. The saved crash stack shows this call enters `seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_()` and reaches the crashing `process_page_()` call through `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()`.

coarse_trace.summary: The witness config selects Ogg chained-stream decoding and its first three commands run `process_until_end_of_stream`, `reset`, and a huge `seek_absolute` on the same decoder object.

During the initial full-stream pass, chained EOS handling reallocates `linkdetails` to the live 80-slot heap buffer later named by ASan; that same allocation bounds the preserved indexed-link count on this buffer to 76..79.
Reset rewinds `current_linknumber` and `current_linknumber_advance_read` but keeps the same 80-slot `linkdetails` array and its indexed-link metadata for the later seek.

The huge seek target is not found in the preserved indexed table, so Ogg seeking loops through `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()`; with runtime disambiguation disabled, the saved artifacts do not isolate which later post-reset transition supplied the final read-ahead index 80.
During a later BOS scan on the same 80-slot table, `process_page_()` accepts the read-ahead index, forms `&linkdetails[80]`, and over-reads `number_of_other_streams`.

fine_trace.note: Harness step. The exact 162876-byte witness begins with config bytes `75 17 ff`, so `ogg = true`, `decode_chained_stream = true`, and `command_length = 15`. The first three command semantics are `process_until_end_of_stream`, `reset`, and `seek_long(0x1000014000000)`; the four trailing `process_until_end_of_stream` opcodes are never reached because the seek already crashes.

Source. The witness-controlled chained-stream bit is first materialized in project code here, making later Ogg EOS handling and seek-time link walking use the chained-link bookkeeping in `ogg_decoder_aspect`.

This is the first project-side consumer of the witness's Ogg-mode bit. Because step 1 set `ogg = true`, initialization commits this run to the Ogg decoder path and carries step 2's chained-stream state into the same `ogg_decoder_aspect` object that later reallocates and reuses `linkdetails`.

During step 1's initial `process_until_end_of_stream`, chained EOS handling reaches this block with `current_linknumber == 75`: ASan's live allocation size is 4480 bytes, so the `5 + current_linknumber` realloc request at line 362 is exactly 80 elements. The block therefore increments `number_of_links_indexed` to 76, grows `linkdetails` to 80 slots (`0..79`), and zeroes slot 76. Because the crash still names this line-362 80-slot allocation, later pre-reset indexing on the same array can raise the preserved count only to 79; any index-79 update would have grown the table to 84 instead.

The second command resets the Ogg aspect for seeking. It rewinds `current_linknumber` and `current_linknumber_advance_read` to 0 and restarts BOS tracking, but it does not free or shrink `linkdetails` and it does not clear indexed-link metadata. The later seek therefore reuses step 4's 80-slot array with a preserved `number_of_links_indexed` that is source-bounded to 76..79.

The third command's `seekpos` becomes `target_sample = 0x1000014000000`. On the saved path that target is not contained in the preserved indexed-link table from step 5, so Ogg seeking enters this loop and keeps calling `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link()` to walk forward through chained-link state on the same decoder object.

In a later `skip_link()` call from step 6, BOS scanning reaches this guard on the same 80-slot array from step 4. Step 9's fault address fixes the read-ahead index here at 80, because the sink reads `linkdetails[80].number_of_other_streams`. With step 5's preserved indexed range 76..79, the predicate `current_linknumber_advance_read >= number_of_links_indexed` is satisfied without implying `number_of_links_indexed == 80`. `run_flags.json` keeps runtime disambiguation off, so the saved artifacts do not isolate which earlier post-reset transition supplied the final value 80.

Root cause. The code trusts step 7's count-based BOS guard and uses `current_linknumber_advance_read` directly as a `linkdetails` index. On the crashing path this forms one-past-end `&aspect->linkdetails[80]` on step 4's live 80-slot array; there is no capacity check against the actual allocation extent.

Sink. This reads a 4-byte field at offset 32 of the one-past-end struct from step 8. ASan reports the faulting address as 32 bytes past the 4480-byte region, which exactly matches `linkdetails[80].number_of_other_streams` when each `FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails` entry is 56 bytes.

evidence_limitations: `run_flags.json` sets `runtime_disambiguation` to `false`, so Stage 02 does not instrument which post-reset `skip_link` / read-side transition assigned the final `current_linknumber_advance_read = 80` before the BOS scan in step 7.

The closed facts are narrower and sufficient: step 4 proves the live line-362 allocation is 80 slots and bounds the preserved indexed-link count on that array to 76..79, step 5 proves reset preserves that state, and steps 6-9 plus the ASan address prove a later seek-time BOS scan uses index 80 on the same array and faults at `process_page_:130`.

allocation_context.note: ASan reports the invalid read is 32 bytes past a 4480-byte heap region last reallocated here. `4480 / sizeof(FLAC__OggDecoderAspect_LinkDetails) = 80`, so the live buffer contains slots `0..79`.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: ASan's allocation stack names the live 4480-byte region allocated at `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_read_callback_wrapper:362`, and the fine trace follows that same preserved 80-slot `linkdetails` buffer through reset to the later `process_page_:128-130` one-past-end read.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes for the saved suffix `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(case 7 after earlier case 0 and case 4) -> FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute -> seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_ -> FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link -> process_page_`. The unresolved part is only which earlier post-reset skip/read transition assigned `current_linknumber_advance_read = 80`, because runtime disambiguation remained disabled.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Partially. Step 4 proves the live 80-slot `linkdetails` allocation and bounds the preserved indexed count on that array to 76..79; step 5 proves reset preserves that state; steps 6-9 plus the ASan address prove a later seek-time BOS scan uses `current_linknumber_advance_read = 80` on that same array. The saved artifacts do not isolate which post-reset transition assigned the final 80.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable run executed `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_371068253 run --version vulnerable --expect crash`, which fed `poc` to `fuzzer_seek` and reproduced `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 4` in `process_page_` with stack `FLAC__ogg_decoder_aspect_skip_link -> seek_to_absolute_sample_ogg_ -> FLAC__stream_decoder_seek_absolute`.

format.name: fuzzer_seek command stream + Ogg FLAC payload
format.contract: The verified trigger semantics are limited to the exact 162876-byte witness `gt_results/arvo_371068253/poc` (sha256 `2c50555c0342b99c87b985722d8c6b1ec3a730abdbbd8d01da085a0564519436`). Its 3-byte config prefix must remain `75 17 ff`, so `init_bools[0]` and `init_bools[4]` still select Ogg mode and chained-stream decoding and `command_length` stays 15. Its command bytes at offsets 3..17 must remain `20 14 27 00 01 00 00 14 00 00 00 00 00 00 00`, i.e. `process_until_end_of_stream`, `reset`, `seek_long(0x1000014000000)`, then four trailing `process_until_end_of_stream` opcodes that are not reached because the seek already crashes. The remaining payload starting at offset 18 must still preserve the malformed/chained Ogg FLAC layout that lets the first full-stream pass reach line 362 and leave the live 80-slot `linkdetails` buffer, lets reset preserve that state, and later makes the huge seek reach `process_page_()` with `linkdetails[80]` on that same allocation. The saved artifacts do not isolate which post-reset advance assigned the final `current_linknumber_advance_read = 80`, so this contract does not generalize beyond the exact witness.
